source_version: Capella (continuously deployed, no discrete version number)

relations.subject: eventing:timer
relations.evidence: The Eventing Function calls a Timer, which executes a callback function before a document expires and retrieves a value from that document. This function then stores a document with the same key in a specified target collection.

relations.subject: eventing:on-update-handler
relations.evidence: Only processes for those documents that have a non-zero TTL

relations.subject: capella:document-expiration
relations.evidence: For information about setting a document's expiration time with SQL++, see [Insert a document with expiration](../n1ql/n1ql-language-reference/insert.md#insert-document-with-expiration).

relations.subject: eventing:function
relations.evidence: For more information about the `cbc` tool, see [Command Line Tools](../reference/command-line-tools.md).

notable_absence.finding: The 'create a test document with expiration' prerequisite offers four equally-weighted paths (SQL++ UPSERT with an options clause, the `cbc` KV CLI client, a Python SDK script, a Java SDK script) with full platform-specific install paths for `cbc` on Linux/macOS/Windows - none of which are Capella-specific; the Linux path (`/opt/couchbase/bin/cbc`) and Windows path (`C:\Program Files\Couchbase\Server\bin\cbc`) are self-managed Couchbase Server paths reused verbatim inside a Capella (`cloud/eventing/`) doc page, the same self-managed-content-bleed pattern the sibling batch already flagged for eventing-function-export.md.

cross_product_finding: This page cites a specific historical defect by ticket ID for a macOS client library issue: 'If you get the error `dyld: Library not loaded` when running `cbc` on macOS, follow the instructions on the Jira ticket [MB-37768](https://issues.couchbase.com/browse/MB-37768).' This is a durable dependency on an external bug tracker rather than a self-contained fix in the docs themselves - a risk if the ticket is ever closed/archived without the fix being folded back into this page.
